pages.text: The device is easier to hear once the surrounding movement stops. It seldom stays quiet for long.
pages.title: Hold the line
An audible machine
pages.text: A defense charter deploys the machine beside its checkpoint. Keep it intact until the countdown ends. Watch the approaches as well as its remaining integrity; your own blows can damage it.

pages.title: Before the first wave
pages.text: Make room to circle the device and keep a clear way back. Attackers can reach it while you are occupied elsewhere.

pages.title: Before the first wave
pages.text: Losing a required device fails the expedition. An optional defense can be lost without ending the route, but its bonus is gone. Read which kind you have before starting.
